summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Platinum Group Metals Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting an amended and restated share compensation plan dated May 28, 2026. The filing contains the full text of the plan, including definitions, award mechanics, settlement options (cash or shares), and change-of-control provisions. There is no merger, acquisition, tender offer, spin-off, activist campaign, or other special situation event. This is a routine compensation plan update, which is an ordinary governance matter, not a special situation.
